scripts.build: cd Backend && npm install && bash ../scripts/prisma-deploy-production.sh && npm run build && test -f dist/main.js
scripts.start: cd Backend && (test -f dist/main.js || npm run build) && node dist/main.js
scripts.deploy:web: export NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://rezervame.onrender.com/api && npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting:web --project rezerveme-1fce5
scripts.deploy:admin: export NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://rezervame.onrender.com/api && npm run build:admin && firebase deploy --only hosting:admin --project rezerveme-1fce5
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:web && npm run deploy:admin && npm run deploy:backend
